title: Brawlhalla
provenance: reported by xlCyanz (highball-db#10), Apple M4, nine sessions on DXMT, unverified by Highball
notes: Plays online. Reported on an M4 over nine sessions on DXMT (the automatic mode, nothing overridden): account login, matchmaking queues, custom rooms with friends, and local matches against bots all worked, with no anti-cheat block, kick or failed handshake, no crashes, no visual corruption, no audio or input problems. DXVK and D3DMetal were not tried. Not tried here.

anticheat.note: Easy Anti-Cheat in its userspace form: online matchmaking and custom rooms were played through it under Wine on an M4 with no block or kick (highball-db#10)
